subject: general
question: Arvind is now 40 years old and Asha is 25 years old. How many years ago from now was Arvind four times as old as Asha?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age difference between **Arvind** and **Asha** is always constant: 40 − 25 = **15 years**.

When **Arvind** was **4 times** as old as **Asha**, the ratio was 4 : 1.

Difference in ratio parts = 4 − 1 = 3 units.

3 units = 15 years ⇒ 1 unit = 5 years (Asha's age then).

Years ago = Current age − Past age = 25 − 5 = **20 years**.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Current age of **Arvind** = 40 years, Current age of **Asha** = 25 years.

**Formula Used:** (Current Age − x) = Ratio × (Other Current Age − x)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed71a2f0d776a03b4d05cee31b9767db7e5f9de0ae954cecd4ec63311cc49053.png] 

Let **x** be the number of years ago.

⇒ (40 − x) = 4 × (25 − x)

⇒ 40 − x = 100 − 4x

⇒ 4x − x = 100 − 40

⇒ 3x = 60

⇒ x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The numerical difference between the ages of two persons remains the same throughout their lives, regardless of the years passed or ratio changes.

Ratio Adjustment Method

If the age ratio is given for two different time periods, multiply the ratios so that the difference between the ratio parts of the two people is equalized.

Future/Past Calculation

To find age 'n' years ago, subtract 'n' from present age. To find age 'n' years hence, add 'n' to present age.</p
